Qoder report unit 5/5, fixture 1/1; изменены integration scripts/native-qoder-herder.mjs, scripts/native-qoder-report.py, tests/native-qoder-report.test.py. Candidate и runtime adapter не менялись; Tesla уведомлён deferred.

changes.result: Bbe987fe6a0704964ad7c fixed: исходный L33 v5 candidate d94b09a8, server-44 isolated Qoder canary RED→GREEN.
